Spotlight: Improving colt who made all for clearcut success in 7f Redcar maiden (good to firm) last month, his third start; needs to make further progress here but that's possible if the drop in trip suits.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a Listed 6f 2yo winner; overcame inexperience to make winning debut at Southwell (5f, AW) in April and also ran well when third at Kempton (6f, AW) the following month; remains open to improvement but this turf debut comes after a three-month break.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Delivered on earlier promise when making all to justify skinny odds on five-runner Salisbury novice (6f, good to firm) last month, her fourth run; contests much deeper race here but not ruled out each-way.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
OwnerName: G H Thompson And Michael Dods
Spotlight: Placed on first two starts, losing out only by a neck at Pontefract (6f, good to firm) on second occasion; that form is below the standard required here, though, and he disappointed on his latest outing (albeit hampered).

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Half-brother to a Group-placed 2yo winner but managed only ninth of 12 on debut at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) in May and needs to have made huge progress during subsequent three-month break.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Five-race maiden who was about 10l behind Zigazig Ah when 18th in Newbury's Super Sprint (5f, good to firm) last month; fared better when close second in recent 6f nursery but faces a tougher task here.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Out of a well-connected French 7f winner; beaten under 1l when third on debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 19 days ago and, although that was just a run-of-the-mill contest, she's open to significant improvement.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Just prevailed in Newbury's valuable Super Sprint last month, her third start, and was not discredited in good-quality conditions race at Glorious Goodwood (also 5f, good to firm) a few days later; should be okay back at 6f and has a fighting chance on these terms.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Made bold bid from the front when clear second to useful rival in Nottingham maiden (6f, good to firm) last month but was below that form when well-held second on AW a fortnight later; others look stronger.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Reportedly unsuited by good to firm ground when disappointing favourite at Windsor last month and will be hoping for some rain here but won Ripon novice (6f, good) two runs ago and still has potential for top stable.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Came good in Class 6 nursery at Ffos Las (5f, good) last month, her fourth run, but has since run poorly over 6f in that grade.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beat subsequent Super Sprint winner Zigazig Ah when winning Lingfield maiden (6f, AW) in June and was close second in five-runner nursery there (6f, good to firm) last month; can collect some prize-money.

RaceName: £200,000 Tattersalls Somerville Auction Stakes (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Lowly rated maiden who would be a shock winner of this.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: 1m4f Roscommon maiden winner went close in a valuable 1m6f handicap here in May off 10lb lower; not disgraced in a 1m4f Group 3 at Cork but hiked up 6lb and beaten 11l on return to a handicap over C&D latest; bit to prove off current mark.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to add to Limerick maiden win (12.5f, good) last summer; step in the right direction on latest at Ballinrobe (1m5f, yielding) when a 4.75l fourth of 8; shorter trip and faster ground here a plus and rider takes off a handy 7lb; not discounted.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Both career wins came over 10.5f and 1m5f at Down Royal last season; running well in defeat this season but handicapper very slow to relent; needs to find a bit more off current mark.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Below best at Dundalk last time but ran a solid race when runner up at Down Royal (1m5f, good) on her penultimate start; heavy defeat in this last year off 1lb higher and remains 5lb above last turf win.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden winner for Andy Oliver last September at Navan when 125-1; narrowly denied on handicap debut on next run at Down Royal (1m5f, yielding) but lost way since and has moved yards; revival needed on stable bow; trainer form a plus.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Generally consistent filly has run crackers in both her handicap starts, over 1m4f at Cork and over 1m2f here on latest when denied by a short head; 5lb higher now but the return to 1m4f should suit, she's preferred by Browne McMonagle and is a big player.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: 1m4f Fairyhouse winner was 3.5l behind Yousaynothingatall over 1m2f here on her handicap debut last month; 3lb better off here so could close the gap stepped back up in distance; chance.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Promise on debut at Gowran (1m, gd-yld) and built on that upped to 12.5f when winning a Limerick fillies' maiden last month; had two subsequent winners behind that day so respected in first handicap but deserted by Browne McMonagle.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time winner has run well on both starts since joining this yard; narrowly denied at Navan (1m2f, good) and beaten just 1.25l when a staying on fourth of 11 at Naas on latest (1m3f, good); should go well again off the same mark upped in trip.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Scored on handicap debut at Naas in June (1m3f, good); raised 4lb and finished last of six upped to 1m5f at Leopardstown; eased 1lb and drops back in trip; much more needed in this deeper race.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Won on debut at Leopardstown in June (1m2f, soft); no impact in first two handicaps on quicker ground at Killarney (11.5f) and Naas (1m3f) when 2.75l behind Letiza; eased another 3lb but may need softer conditions.

RaceName: Neville O'Byrne Memorial Irish EBF Fillies & Mares Handicap
Spotlight: Course winner off this mark last year over 7f; zero luck in running when a close sixth over 1m here on latest; yet to run over this far a trip but her dam was a 1m4f winner so decent prospects of staying the trip; big chance if she does.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Form figures of 22216 at York; Wednesday's sixth can be upgraded as he was comfortably on top of those drawn high; returning to 6f should suit and he is proven on slow ground, for all that his best efforts have been on good to firm; high on the list.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: His career has been one of steady but consistent progress; won at Epsom (6f, soft) and the Currragh (6.2f, good to firm) this season and ran a sound race in the Stewards' Cup at Goodwood, perhaps finding that sharp test on fast ground inadequate; can't call upon course form but the weather has turned in his favour and he has another major handicap in him.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Inconsistent but he is a smart performer, as when beating his 21 rivals at Doncaster last November (6f, heavy); raced exclusively at 7f since, with mixed results, but this mark isn't beyond him and a big run could be on the cards back down in distance.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: The winner of four of his nine starts, advancing his form to the next level when winning the Stewards' Cup at Goodwood (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; handles soft; up 4lb but there could well be more in the tank; stable also represented by Fine Interview.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: The winner of five of his 12 starts (5.7f-6f) since joining James Owen last summer; fourth and sixth in major handicaps on last two starts and it would seem highly likely that he will give his running once again; appears to handle any ground.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: The winner of three of his five starts in cheekpieces, including a smooth success at Doncaster (6f, good to soft) on return in March; failed to fire at Epsom (6f, soft; behind Sondad) 11 weeks ago but this stablemate of Evening Saigon shouldn't be passed over lightly.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Has raced exclusively at 7f, winning four of her 12 starts; overcame a wide draw and trouble in running to win at Chester (7f, good) three weeks ago, showing a bright turn of foot and having more in hand than the 1l winning margin might suggest; up 4lb ahead of this belated first 6f run but the way she travels through her races offers serious encouragement that she will improve for it; tops the list.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Money-spinner for connections down the years; recent efforts have suggested he retains a good deal of his ability and his handicap mark is easing; beaten only 3l in a 7f Group 1 at this meeting 12 months ago; each-way shout.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: All wins on AW but he is fully effective on turf; unplaced in two C&D runs this year, however, and hopes appear to rest on the return of a visor giving him a lift.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Began the season with two dominant 5f wins on AW; well short of his best on last three starts and there are risks attached, despite his favourable mark.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Won well at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in June and some stiff tasks since; still looked in form when sixth at Windsor 12 days ago but this is a tougher race and he looks vulnerable once again, even with Ryan Moore booked.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
OwnerName: L Bond & Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi
Spotlight: Back in top form for David O'Meara this summer, running well twice at Glorious Goodwood and again when third of 21 here (5.4f, good) on Wednesday; tanked through Wednesday's race but didn't see it out quite so well as the front two; the worry today is that further rain has fallen and he is ideally suited by good to firm.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Has relatively low mileage and wasn't beaten far in the Stewards' Cup three weeks ago; this looks too competitive once again though.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Three wins in France (7f-1m) and he made a satisfactory start for Kevin Ryan when sixth of 11 in a useful race at Thirsk (1m, good) three weeks ago; has his first 6f run in this deep race.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Big chance on his 3yo best but he hasn't got anything going in three runs in big sprint handicaps this year (had wind operation prior to his return); conditions should be fine and the new cheekpieces could give him a lift; revival not out of the question.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Comfortable win at Carlisle (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) in May but he has come up short in the Wokingham and Stewards' Cup since; this looks no easier and he will need to be at the top of his game.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: In good form this year and he took it to a new level when powering home to win the 5.4f handicap here on Wednesday; has had few chances at 6f (third to Stratusnine over C&D last month) and will be fine on good to soft (more to prove should it get slower); respected under a 5lb penalty.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Ended 2025 with a Doncaster win and a narrow defeat in the Ayr Gold Cup (6f, soft); had a wind operation after the Ayr run but two heavy defeats this summer have seen him undergo another wind surgery; on a dangerous mark but Ayr next month might be the big target; cheekpieces back on today.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: He has not looked back since dropping to 6f in May, winning three times including an impressive success at the Shergar Cup at Ascot (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; two solid C&D runs on his record too but a 6lb rise since Ascot, allied to slower ground, could find him out; the only 3yo in the field and that age group have won the last two renewals.

RaceName: Sky Bet Constantine Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
Spotlight: Style of racing leaves him a hostage to fortune but he has the ability to win a big prize when things pan out favourably; latest C&D second has been well advertised since and he wasn't well drawn there; 2lb rise should be fine and he has form on slow ground; one to consider.

RaceName: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Way better chaser than a 1-18 return suggests (Grade 2 winner), and not too far off his best despite finishing just sixth in the Summer Plate latest; terrific strike-rate as a hurdler (ran up a five-timer in 2022), but continued effectiveness over these obstacles untested since autumn 2023.

RaceName: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: The wheels came off following last November's Listed Fairyhouse win for Willie Mullins (yielding to soft), and nothing about either start for latest handler has suggested an imminent revival; yet to convince beyond 2m.

RaceName: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Made all in a C&D 0-115 in May (good) off 6lb lower; has it to prove that this isn't as good as he is nowadays, a subsequent Uttoxeter failure having come in a Class 2 which looks no stronger than today's.

RaceName: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 4-4 over hurdles in class 2 or lower for Jamie Snowden, always making all; not seen since landing a 2m4f Worcester Class 2 (effectively a 0-135) in July 2025, but pace rivalry here concerns at least as much.

RaceName: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 2m1f mares' novice winner on sole previous course visit in 2024, but this last spring's far superior form efforts win or lose were recorded over stayers' trips; didn't offer anything on last month's Flat return.

RaceName: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Interesting he was still staying on into fourth (about 23l ahead of Letterston Lily) at the end of a generously run Summer Hurdle last time, though remains untried beyond a sharp 2m4f; 7lb higher mark than for June's easy 2m1f win here leaves him with almost nothing in hand.

RaceName: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Defied 17-month absence at Perth in April (2m4f, good) before finding things happening too quickly in the Summer Hurdle latest; new trip asks a question, but notable her full sister has won over further still.

RaceName: Aubrey Loze Memorial Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
OwnerName: The Old Stag Racing Sy Partnership
Spotlight: 2-2 in stayers' handicaps here; June's Hexham third to Divilabother (hat-trick scorer subsequently) looks better form now than then, and he's resumed winning ways over a 2m4f trip at the lowest end of his range since; disinterest in contesting the early pace might prove an asset today; big player.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: No match for the useful-looking Mill Reef entry Pure Mint on last month's Ripon debut (good to firm), but had a next-time winner behind; consolidated rather than built upon that effort over the same C&D last weekend, but wouldn't need to find much improvement to go close here.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Nephew of Albany Stakes winner Cuis Ghaire and has plenty to offer over 6f as a 2yo himself, judged on last month's Newcastle debut fourth when beaten under 1l; RPR of 72 just sets the standard in this line-up, and no reason why he'd struggle to translate that ability to turf.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Fared only marginally better for gelding at Newcastle latest, and yet to see out 6f at all convincingly; may need more time.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: May's 3l second on debut here (7f, good) is the strongest piece of turf form on offer; weakening effort at Ayr since was owed to a refusal to settle rather than stamina issues, and this drop to 6f can't rate an obvious plus for one quite so stoutly bred (1m3f-2m winners in pedigree).

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Still had running left when badly hampered 2f out on last month's Thirsk debut (6f, good to firm); good chance he'll prove better than that here; yard's 2yos have got off the mark for 2026 in the interim.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Unable to break out of rear on either start so far, beating nothing home over 7f latest; one for later on.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: 125-1, refused to settle in rear on last month's Newcastle debut (6f), finishing well held just behind Ubetawatchout; way more needed.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: 52,000euros yearling whose siblings have variously struck in everything from British sprints (some useful form) to Czech hurdles; yard's 2yos not wildly prolific yet this term, but she starts at a realistic level.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: 9-1 fourth favourite, 13l last of seven on this month's Nottingham debut (6f, good to firm), short of room at one stage but by no means unlucky; plenty more required.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Calyx half-brother to winners at 5f-7f (one useful) out of a half-sister to the prolific pair Two Tempting (runs at Chester today) and Sweet Reward; just the Frost yard's second 2yo of 2026 (the other is 0-4).

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: By Aclaim but sprint winners wherever you look among his siblings and the damside pedigree, notably Eastern Romance (French 2yo Listed scorer); most appealing of the newcomers and well worth a market check.

RaceName: Every Race Live On Racing TV EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B/C/D) (EBF Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: June's C&D restricted novice second (good; beaten almost 5l) represented a fair step up on her debut effort, and the fourth won next time out; just a little more improvement ought to have her thereabouts.

RaceName: Old Market Lane Traders Novice Chase
OwnerName: Patrick Corbett & Michael Corbett & J J Corbett & W Clancy
Spotlight: Several near misses before getting off the mark in spectacular fashion over 3m7f at Punchestown in April; up 12lb for that and was unable to make any impression in the Midlands National at Kilbeggan; far from an easy task here conceding weight over a trip possibly short of his best but clearly a big player.

RaceName: Old Market Lane Traders Novice Chase
Spotlight: Gradually coming to hand over fences and recovered from a bad run at Fairyhouse at Easter when easily landing a decent beginners chase over C&D in May; one of the ones to beat if reproducing that.

RaceName: Old Market Lane Traders Novice Chase
Spotlight: Wide margin winner of an ordinary contset at Wexford in March; mixed bag since and not done many favours by his jumping at Galway latest; small field and possibly slower gallop may help but more needed in any case.

RaceName: Old Market Lane Traders Novice Chase
Spotlight: Point form amounts to nothing and has shown nothing in two starts for this yard; no chance here.

RaceName: Old Market Lane Traders Novice Chase
Spotlight: Five time winner over hurdles; fell on her chasing debut here in May when holding every chance and made up for that at Tramore later in the month; faded after a mistake two out at Punchestown in June when last seen; has something to find on ratings but gets the allowances and should fare well if her jumping holds up.

RaceName: Kore Systems Handicap
Spotlight: Easy 5f win on soft ground at Yarmouth in May; fine second of 18 at Glorious Goodwood last month before looking stretched by 6f at Brighton 15 days ago; high on the list back at 5f.

RaceName: Kore Systems Handicap
Spotlight: Promise as a 2yo and his seasonal return at Thirsk was encouraging too; not at his best at Musselburgh 15 days ago but he is edging down the weights.

RaceName: Kore Systems Handicap
Spotlight: Never dangerous but did keep on steadily for fourth over C&D (good ground) four weeks ago; something to prove on slower than good.

RaceName: Kore Systems Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent racer; three wins earlier in the season and she ran as well as she ever has when second of eight at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) last month; well drawn to attack; handles good to soft but unraced on slower.

RaceName: Kore Systems Handicap
Spotlight: Attracted support at Beverley (5f, good to firm) ten days ago and didn't run badly in fourth of the ten runners; seems to handle any ground and she is one to consider.

RaceName: Kore Systems Handicap
Spotlight: 7f winner who stays 1m; no threat in two sprint runs for Ian Williams; will be of more interest when stepped back up in trip.

RaceName: Kore Systems Handicap
Spotlight: Good series of efforts ground to a halt at York (5.4f, good to firm) 29 days ago; needs a full revival but she has run well on soft so rain wouldn't be an issue.

RaceName: Blackwell Earthmoving 70th Anniversary Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Landed big prize over this trip on Rowley Mile (good to firm) on 1,000 Guineas day in May and was close third in another heritage handicap over C&D (good to firm) when reappearing last month; nudged up only 2lb for that and in much calmer waters today; good chance.

RaceName: Blackwell Earthmoving 70th Anniversary Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Three wins this season (1m4f-1m6f); bounced back from poor AW run when close second to Arqoob here (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago and might still have a bigger performance in him over this longer trip; respected.

RaceName: Blackwell Earthmoving 70th Anniversary Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won this race comfortably in first-time blinkers a year ago and looked back in prime form when keeping on well to beat Sixpack here (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; only 2lb higher today; has another big role to play.

RaceName: Blackwell Earthmoving 70th Anniversary Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: In the frame all six starts this season, and might have bumped into a smart one when second off today's mark at Kempton (1m4f, AW) ten days ago; also suited by turf and won't be far away if stamina holds out over new trip.

RaceName: Blackwell Earthmoving 70th Anniversary Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Still 6lb higher than for emphatic win at York (extended 1m2f, good) in May but ran well when fifth of 13 at Glorious Goodwood (1m3f, good to firm); not out of this if suited by the new trip (first run beyond 1m4f).

RaceName: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger Trial Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Last year's Queen's Vase winner over this trip and beaten a little over 3l when fifth of seven in St Leger; stepped up to 2m and switched from blinkers to a visor at Down Royal in May when beating Layfayette (recd 4lb) by over 2l, with Dallas Star further back; found 2m4f and far more demanding company too much for him in the Gold Gold; softening ground at York has seen him rerouted from yesterday's Lonsdale Stakes, and this is more winnable; tongue-tie added.

RaceName: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger Trial Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Well-beaten second to Leinster in weaker four-runner renewal of this last year, and no match for Carmers at Down Royal in May; on a long losing sequence and will be a big price; usually leads.

RaceName: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger Trial Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Rated 6lb below stablemate, and last year's winner, Leinster but is on a roll and the champion jockey prefers his chance; hurdling during the winter; won a Killarney conditions event over this trip in May which, remarkably, produced three of the first four home in the Ascot Stakes (2m4f), which he won grittily off 92.

RaceName: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger Trial Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: 11 wins in all, and seven of them at stakes level; C&D winner on heavy in April and Listed winner over extended 1m4f on soft at Limerick in June; held in Leopardstown Group 3 on quicker ground last time; second to Carmers over 2m at Down Royal back in May and now 4lb worse off.

RaceName: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger Trial Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Readily beat Dallas Star in last year's weaker renewal, but was tailed off in Irish St Leger; respectable runs behind top stayer Scandinavia on goodish ground first two starts this term; well beaten on soft behind Layfayette in June; overlooked by stable jockey; tongue-tie goes on.

RaceName: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger Trial Stakes (Group 3)
Spotlight: Only a maiden win to his name, but he's a smart stayer; placed in the Ebor and Irish Cesarewitch last year, and in pair of French Group 1s at the back-end; 300-day absence and will surely improve for the run.

RaceName: Comer Group International Irish St. Leger Trial Stakes (Group 3)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Maiden winner over 1m2f at Leopardstown; second to Limestone in 1m5f Listed contest at Navan in May; couple of lengths further behind taht rival when Limestone followed up in Queen's Vase at Royal Ascot, where quicker ground may not have suited.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: All starts at 5f; front-runner who made it 3-3 (soft-good) with conditions race win at Chester in May and returned from a break with fine third in the Group 3 Molecomb at Glorious Goodwood; holds leading form claims and this track should suit his style.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Runner-up on first two starts (5f, good to soft/good to firm), behind a notable rival on the second occasion, and bounced back from a heavy 6f Listed defeat at Royal Ascot with cosy win in small-field nursery at Haydock (5f, good); this attractively bred colt is respected back up in grade.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Runner-up in two 6f maidens (AW/good), the latest a big field at Glorious Goodwood, either side of a respectable seventh of 25 in the Listed Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); he's hung on his last two starts but stall 1 should help in that regard and this pacy sort could be suited by today's first crack at 5f; each-way possibilities.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
OwnerName: Future Champions Racing Syn & Mps Racing
Spotlight: Comfortable win in a Hamilton maiden (5f, good to soft) in June on third start and short-headed in big-field nursery at Glorious Goodwood (6f, good to firm) subsequently under Ryan Moore, who retains the ride; he's on the up and could give another good account.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: All four starts over 5f on good to firm; massively outran his 150-1 odds when runner-up in the Group 2 Norfolk at Royal Ascot and he was a respectable fifth in the Group 3 Molecomb at Goodwood since; has around 3l to find with Molecomb runner-up Adonius but might not be far away.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Placed in maidens (soft/good) on first three starts before close Listed third at Naas (5f, good), and he got off the mark in a maiden at Cork (5f, good to firm) last time; however, there have been mixed messages from the Naas form and he needs to take a step forward in first-time cheekpieces.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Second to Adonius at Chester (5f, good) in May then made all in the Woodcote conditions stakes at Epsom (6f, good to soft); he's come up short in Group 2 races on his last two starts (6f, good to firm) but shaped on each occasion as though he might benefit from this return to 5f; not discounted.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Displayed considerable improvement in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) when easily making all in a maiden at Ffos Las (6f, good) last month on his fifth start; again showed blistering pace in the Group 2 Richmond at Goodwood (6f, good to firm) last time prior to fading; could be far more of a force today back down in trip and in grade.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Won on debut at Hamilton (5f, good to firm) in May and respectable fifth in Listed races on next two starts (6f, good to firm); best run when 4l fourth in the Group 3 Molecomb at Goodwood last time (5f, good to firm; Adonius second); each-way player.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Second on debut in the Hilary Needler at Beverley (5f, good to firm) and bounced back from a disappointing run at Catterick (5f, good to firm) with easy win in a match at Nottingham (5f, good to firm; beat a newcomer); others have a lot more substance to their form but it's hard to identify the limit of her ability; this £165,000 breeze-up buy is not ruled out each-way.

RaceName: Julia Graves Roses Stakes (Listed Race)
Spotlight: She's finished in the first three on all four starts (5f/6f, good to soft-good to firm); capable of winning races but a transformation is needed if she's to come out on top in this one.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: Improved to win a 7f seller at Musselburgh (good ground) in June; the odd good nursery run has followed and she's respected despite having to shoulder a penalty.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: Runner-up in all three nursery starts (7f, good or good to firm), the latest at Musselburgh 15 days ago; solid claims at the weights now dropping into a seller.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: Well beaten in two 7f novice runs this month; connections wasted little time dropping him into a seller and it will be interesting to see if there is any money about for him.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: 7,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to 6f 2yo winner Sapphire Steps (RPR 83); dam 7f 2yo/1m winner (89); enough paper appeal to warrant a look in the betting.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: 33-1 when always behind on his debut at Thirsk (6f, good) last week; quickly dropped in class; stable also runs Here's To It.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: Big prices and well beaten in two maidens in June; drops in class with a point to prove.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: Little short-term promise in novice events at Wolverhampton (6f) or Haydock (7f, good) this summer; from a powerful yard but not easily recommended.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: 5,500gns yearling; seventh foal; half-sister to winners Skilled Warrior (7.3f turf/1m AW; RPR 96), Rumbo Norte (French 1m2f-1m4f; 80), Maguro (French 9.5f AW; 77) and Statham (Swiss 1m1f); dam French 1m 2yo winner (including Listed; 95); won't have to be anything out of the ordinary to feature and the betting will guide; stable also runs Hope Of Acklam.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: 18,000euros yearling; third foal; half-sister to 1m1f turf/1m3f AW winner It's Only Fun (RPR 76); unraced dam closely related to 6f Listed winner and Irish 1,000 Guineas runner-up Dimenticata; starts out at a low level; check the betting.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
Spotlight: Some promise in three runs for Karl Burke but a well-beaten last in both runs for her new stable; steps up in trip on a recovery mission.

RaceName: Watch Racing TV Now Selling Stakes
OwnerName: Mohamed Rashid Hamdan Al Saadi & Partner
Spotlight: Lowly RPRs in a couple of AW runs (7f/1m) this summer; drops in class and switches to turf but still has too much to prove for comfort.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Mostly stiff tasks since arrival in Britain but disappointing even so, posing zero threat in the Summer Hurdle latest; hard to entertain despite this easier grade, and winless on sound turf surfaces also.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Appeared unlucky to go down by under a length at Ascot in March (traffic issues), but didn't enjoy himself in the Summer Hurdle on sole start since; still early days in handicaps, and no ground issues.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Mrs S D Pearson & Ollie Pears
Spotlight: Front-runner; C&D record reads 111244, albeit Arctic Voyage beat her 11l here in July and she finished 27l fourth in this race last year; back on her last winning mark, but vulnerable to less exposed types.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Didn't kick on over fences during a light 2025-26 campaign; interesting to see whether the all-the-way tactics of his earlier Newcastle and Hereford non-handicap hurdle wins are reprised with Max Of Stars in opposition.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ground perhaps softer than advertised when beaten 26l here in June, but otherwise 3-4 when completing for current handler, readily accounting for Max Of Stars and Charlus over C&D latest (good); another personal best required off a mark 4lb higher than any RPR ever run to.

RaceName: Sun Racing Summer Jumps Championship Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Nearly 6l too good for Mojito Des Mottes in taking a Market Rasen juvenile last December (2m1f, good to soft), but sold out of Warren Greatrex's yard after a moderate handicap debut; this wouldn't be any easier, but no surprise were the wind surgery, tongue tie and/or move to his top new connections to prove transformative.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: High-class performer, and acts well around here having won over hurdles and a Grade 3 chase over this trip in May; found to have burst after unseating in the Galway Plate; back on comfortable territory here and keeps many of these out of the handicap.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
OwnerName: Shanahan/Mrs M V Magnier/Mrs Carthy/Mrs Bartlett
Spotlight: Looked to have lost his way in points and hunter chases but came back to his very best when landing the Midlands National at Kilbeggan; never competitive in the Galway Plate but has a stellar record at this venue and should run a big race.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Sole win was in a mares' chase at Sligo last October; good runs in defeat in two handicaps at Punchestown; didn't quite get up the hill in the Galway Blazers but this trip and track is likely to suit well; contender.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Completed a hat-trick over fences in October but backward steps have followed; not disgraced in the Midlands National but needs to up his game here.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Went up 9lb for a decisive success in quite a valuable 2m handicap chase at Cork in October; won a Downpatrick handicap hurdle after six months off in June before fading rapidly at Galway; first run off her new chase mark here and interesting to see if she is as effective back up in trip; definite chance if she is.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Ended a long losing run when winning a nice pot at Limerick in December off 3lb lower; modest efforts since, including in the Galway Blazers last time; ground in her favour and running off correct mark are the main positives.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Rewarded for some consistent efforts when getting up close home for a game success at Kilbeggan two weeks ago; sound jumper and stays well so might not be far away.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Seven-time winner over hurdles and fences; won a Listed handicap chase over 2m1f at Fairyhouse in November, but it's been mostly downhill since; showed a spark over hurdles at Kilbeggan last time; 3lb wrong here.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Rewarded for some consistent performances when landing a 2m3f handicap chase at Wexford last month; scoped badly at Galway since; 6lb higher than Wexford but still 3lb wrong here.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Got to the front some way out and held on to win the 3m Connacht National at Roscommon; mid-division off 8lb higher in the Galway Blazers last time; 4lb wrong here and has it to do.

RaceName: Canella Lane Handicap Chase (Listed Race)
Spotlight: Gained a third career win in a 2m3f handicap chase at Wexford two weeks ago; small penalty for that still leaves him 8lb wrong here; difficult task.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: Back to the mark off which he won a 5f handicap at the May meeting; not had optimal conditions since but returning to 6f and dropping in class could see a revival from this eight-time course winner.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: Lightly raced 3yo; didn't run badly in a C&D handicap (good; hooded first time) last month; slower ground and stall 13 are obvious concerns this time; change of headgear.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Won three novice events in the spring; well held in his two handicaps but this is a drop in class and he may yet tap back into that early promise.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: He has been revived by a switch to AW of late, finishing a close third at Wolverhampton (6f) last month before a dominant win back at that track 22 days ago; up 6lb but still feasibly weighted on his turf best; big player from a handy draw.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins this year, the latest a front-running C&D success in June; solid third off this mark at Hamilton 11 days ago; has other pace to contend with this time.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: Won his first two starts (6f, good and soft); generally struggled since but his reappearance third at Pontefract (only run in cheekpieces) was a promising effort; sold for 58,000gns since latest; starts out for David Loughnane off a reduced mark; worth a market check.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: Big chance on this year's best efforts but his form dipped at York in June and last week's Great St Wilfrid seventh wasn't great either; unraced on slower than good; not sure what to expect.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: 7f win at Thirsk in May and also went close over 7f here a fortnight later; not so good since, including when dropped to 6f at Ripon last week.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: Won four times on AW for James Tate; good second at Southwell (6f) when last seen in April; sold for 13,000gns later that month; switching to turf is the obvious concern as he has been unplaceed in three previous runs on grass.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: Not the force of old but handicapped accordingly; only seen once since February and he didn't offer a great deal; usually held up so he will need plenty of luck in running from the inside stall.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: Course regular; C&D win in May and he went in again at Redcar (5f, good to firm) two weeks ago; only 1lb higher and should give it another good go.

RaceName: Powells Jewellery Handicap
Spotlight: Series of good runs this year, most recently a dominant success at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) ten days ago; that wasn't far off his very best and he's one to consider up 4lb.

RaceName: Polhill Cutting Handicap
Spotlight: Led close home to win this race a year ago (good to firm) and was back on the scoresheet with another narrow success at Musselburgh (5f, good) a fortnight ago; likely contender.

RaceName: Polhill Cutting Handicap
Spotlight: Completed 6f hat-trick for William Haggas in spring 2025; midfield on both starts for new stable this summer but looked unlucky not to finish close to the target here (6f, good to firm; denied clear run) a week ago and has possibilities if suited by this drop in trip.

RaceName: Polhill Cutting Handicap
OwnerName: Moulton Racing And Mrs A Jordan
Spotlight: Low-mileage filly who kept on well for second when dropped to 5f at Ascot (good to firm) last month, her second handicap; will be a potent threat off same mark here if first-time cheekpieces have any positive effect.

RaceName: Polhill Cutting Handicap
Spotlight: Largely consistent 4yo who won readily under Olivia Haines at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) last month; 5lb higher in a higher-grade race here but ought to give another good account.

RaceName: Polhill Cutting Handicap
Spotlight: Disappointed when dropped back to 5f in June and absent for ten weeks since but was commendable third of 18 on seasonal debut at Ascot (6f, good to firm) in May and is now 1lb lower; player if back on song.

RaceName: Polhill Cutting Handicap
Spotlight: Left Clive Cox after beginning this campaign with two poor runs (1m/7f), and there has been no upturn after two starts for new stable (6f/7f); drops to 5f with huge amount to prove.

RaceName: Polhill Cutting Handicap
Spotlight: Won seven in a row over 6f on AW at start of this year but has returned from a break with three down-the-field turf runs, the latest here (6f, good to firm) eight days ago.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Two AW wins this year during a busy campaign; sole turf win came here over 5f a year ago but below best in recent starts and remains 8lb above that last success.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Regained the winning thread over C&D two weeks ago when wearing this headgear combination for the first time; has gone up 6lb but rider's 7lb claim negates that; should give another good account.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Started the season slowly but back on song with a fine run here 6 days ago, running on well for a 1.25l second; same mark here and worth another go at 6f on the evidence of that last run; chance.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time winner has posted solid back-to-back efforts over 5f at Naas and here last week (short head behind Soulful Diva); return to 6f looks a plus and place claims at least again off unchanged mark.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden has been knocking on the door and went close again over C&D last time when a 0.5l second behind Mint Man; nudged up 1lb for that but has to be on the shortlist in current form.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: 1-21 but has finished runner up on five occasions; hasn't built on promising seasonal return over C&D but is lurking on a dangerous mark if rediscovering her best.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden winner ran a fine race in a Naas 3yo premier handicap (6f, good) in May off 6lb higher mostly modest form since; below par at Bellewstown last time but yard hitting form and can't discount in new headgear.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Best run yet for this yard a 1.25l fifth of 13 over 6f at Naas when last sighted in May; 2lb lower now and has won twice over C&D but all three career wins on soft and heavy ground; rain would boost claims.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't really fired so far this season but has been running over 7f-1m; blinkers added to tongue tie worn last time and drops back to trip he won his maiden over; not dismissed for yard coming into form.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Took a step forward from previous form when running on late for a 3.25l fifth of 15 at Fairyhouse (7f, good) last time; mark unchanged but not sure this drop in trip will suit on the evidence of that last effort.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Promise in AW maiden over 5f in December; no impact on handicap debut and seasonal return at Cork (5f, good) 8 days ago; eased 1lb and moves up in trip now; others appeal more.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't shown a whole lot in maidens and not obviously well treated for handicap debut but with a top yard and bred to win races; could take a step forward; check the market.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
OwnerName: R Scahill, S Begley, J & C Bourke
Spotlight: Runner up in a 7f Cork maiden on testing ground back in May; okay effort on handicap debut at Leopardstown in June (1m, good) but unplaced in a rated race and a maiden last twice; new tongue tie needs to eke out more.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Best form is on the AW but was only 2l behind Mint Man over C&D on latest, his first try over 6f; could sneak into the money off the same mark with a repeat.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
OwnerName: P R Dowling & Ms G Brennan
Spotlight: Definite ability in maidens at 7f-1m on yielding and soft ground; drop back to 6f could suit on handicap debut; faster ground a query but market check advised.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Won off 1lb lower on seasonal return at Fairyhouse (6f, good); below best in three runs since and was slowly away when midfield at Navan on latest; needs a revival.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Won on handicap debut at Down Royal in May (5f, good) off 6lb lower; fine effort off revised mark at Navan over 5f (good); below that level at Cork latest (5f, good) but step up to 6f could unlock further improvement; chance.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner is 0-14 on turf but has run well in defeat at times; below best over 7f at Galway on latest but fine run on penultimate start over 6f at Navan (Poweraccclaim 1.25l behind); thereabouts if repeating that.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Promising start in handicaps when a 1.25l second at Fairyhouse (6f, good) but soundly beaten twice since; new headgear combination needs to spark.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Ordinary form in 7f maidens; similar story on handicap debut over C&D 13 days ago when down the field behind Mint Man; eased 3lb but much more needed.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Showed little in four turf maidens last year but won on handicap debut at Dundalk in November; good third over that C&D when last seen in February; probably best watched on return to turf unless the market speaks.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: On long losing run but did shape well over extended 6f here (yielding) in June off 1lb lower; needs to bounce back from a moderate run over 7f at Naas last time.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Narrowly denied off 4lb lower at Cork on penultimate (6f, gd-fm) when coming from the back; weakened behind Mint Man here on latest when ridden more positively; cheekpieces go on now.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Failed to win in Britain and not much encouragement to take from three runs for this stable; too keen at Naas on latest and others look more convincing.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Maiden yet to display winning potential; seventh in first two handicaps at Leopardstown and Killarney, both over 1m; drops in trip and cheekpieces go on.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
OwnerName: Dan Kiely & C O'Neill & Apollo Thoroughbreds
Spotlight: Standout effort a 3.5l third at Down Royal in May (7f, good); 2lb lower here but has failed to replicate that form twice since; previous 6f runs have been poor.

RaceName: Friends Of Moorefield GAA Handicap
Spotlight: Won off basement mark at Naas (5f, good) in June; running okay without threatening to win in three starts since; 6f fine but 2lb wrong here and others preferred.

RaceName: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has reportedly been plagued by injuries and hasn't been able to build on his sole win at Newcastle AW last October; still 4lb above his winning mark but does seem more effective on AW.

RaceName: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Recorded his first win since landing a Group 3 in August 2023 at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm) 16 days ago in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) off 3lb lower; his overall profile doesn't suggest he is likely to follow up.

RaceName: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Sole success came when trained in France last September; has run to a consistent level in four runs for his current trainer this term without suggesting a win is imminent but dons first-time cheekpieces which may have a positive impact.

RaceName: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Two-time winner, the latest on the turf track here (1m2f, soft) in June; needs to show he is as effective on AW.

RaceName: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Completed a five-timer at Haydock last summer; still 5lb above her last winning mark and continues to look in the handicapper's grip.

RaceName: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Three promising efforts before disappointing when beaten 17l on handicap debut at Yarmouth (11.5f, soft; 11-4) in June; still early days and may warrant another chance back on AW and down in trip.

RaceName: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Placed four times last year but beaten around 20l on return at this track (1m4f) in April; subsequently left Ralph Beckett for 10,000gns and has had wind surgery; best watched on stable debut.

RaceName: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Progressive 4yo who landed his third win of the year, at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) last month in gritty fashion; no disgrace in going down by a neck at Hamilton (8.5f, good) three weeks ago and remains in top form; worth following on this step up in trip.

RaceName: Pink Lady Find Your Fizz Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Sole success came at Kempton last May; made the frame on all three starts this summer and should give another good account.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has raced only on good/good to firm when on turf; 4yo who was having only the fifth start of his career when landing the 22-runner John Smith's Cup over C&D six weeks ago; an 8lb rise means a Group-class performance will be needed to follow up but no surprise were he to find it.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: His two wins here came on good to firm but he also acts on soft; respectable seventh of 22 to Raammee in the John Smith's Cup over C&D (good to firm) latest; being eased 2lb is a help but it may not be quite enough.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Fourth in the John Smith's Cup over C&D and Cambridgeshire over 1m1f at Newmarket (both good to firm) on joining this yard last year and opened the current campaign with a win back at Newmarket (1m1f, good to firm again) in May; another creditable effort when sixth of 28 in Royal Hunt Cup at Ascot since, despite leaving the impression even a stiff 1m was a little on the short side; had winning form on softer than good in Ireland much earlier in his career; likely to be on the premises.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressive this year, finishing strongly to win at Leopardstown (1m2f, yielding to soft) in April; good second back there three months later and an eye-catcher when sixth of 17 to Al Aali at Glorious Goodwood (1m2f, good) since, finishing strongly having been denied a clear run and still had plenty to do over 1f out; bold show on the cards.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Formerly a miler but has gained last three wins over 1m2f, including this race on good (made all) last year; latest success came in Bahrain in January; well beaten in the John Smith's Cup on his return to Britain but bounced straight back with a career-best second of 11 over 1m at Thirsk (good) under Lexie Clarkson three weeks ago; going softer than good would be a slight question mark.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Back to form with a bang in blinkers last month and built on his win in a small field at Newmarket by following up in a 17-runner Glorious Goodwood handicap (1m2f, good; acts on good to soft) with four of today's rivals behind; should remain competitive off 5lb higher.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressive 3yo for Andrew Balding in the first half of last year, culminating in a 1m2f handicap win at Royal Ascot (good to firm); sold for 775,000gns the following month but comfortably held in three major 1m2f handicaps on return for new yard this summer; back to only 1lb above the mark he defied at Royal Ascot but a leap of faith is needed.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: M Hughes, M Kerr-Dineen And Partners
Spotlight: Group placed as 2yo and he's run well in top 3yo only handicaps over 1m2f this summer, finishing second of 14 at Glorious Goodwood (good to firm; probably acts on good to soft) off this mark last time; respected with Oisin Murphy taking the reins for the first time.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won at Pontefract (1m2f, good) in April; respectable fifth of 15 over C&D (good) at the Dante meeting in May but well held twice since, latterly at 100-1 in the John Smith's Cup.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Unraced on softer than good; latest seventh of 17 to Al Aali at Glorious Goodwood was respectable but took his handicap record to 0-9; others are preferred for win purposes again.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Bred to stay 1m2f; all three 2yo starts were on softer than good, with a promising debut before he easily justified long odds-on favouritism over 1m in a maiden at Sandown and novice at Haydock (by 11l); this is a slightly belated reappearance and he has a tricky draw for one so inexperienced, but his untapped potential is obvious.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Scored twice in 2024 and three times in 2025; back to best when second in useful 1m handicap here (good to firm; acts on soft) last month but only eighth of 11 at Thirsk since and his peak RPRs (including all wins) have been achieved at about 1m.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won on soft as 2yo; good C&D record includes a third in this race last year and two placed efforts (latterly John Smith's Cup) in a hood this summer; the hood was left off when well beaten over 1m4f at Ascot a fortnight ago but returns now; capable of bouncing back with each-way claims at a venue which suits, particularly with the yard going well.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ended his time with Charlie Appleby on a low note (March 2024) and no revival in his four races at Meydan for another yard the following winter; 483 days off and switched stables again before well beaten at Epsom and Goodwood this summer; lots to prove.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Two wins (1m1f/1m, good) for Dermot Weld in Ireland last year; second start for current yard when runner-up at Chester (7f, good) in May; three poor runs followed but back to form in blinkers (retained here) when second of nine back at Chester (extended 7f, good) six weeks ago; needs to prove his stamina and that he can string good efforts together.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Winner at Epsom (8.5f, good) in April; best run since when close fourth of 15 at Glorious Goodwood (1m1f, good to firm) in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) three weeks ago; can race freely but the Goodwood effort suggests 1m2f could be within range; enters calculations.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Back to form with a bang when scoring comfortably over C&D (good to firm) six weeks ago, his 20th outing at this track; retains handicapping scope on old form after a 6lb rise but he's yet to win back to back.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won at Hamilton (1m1f, good) in May on second start for yard and third past the post (demoted to fifth) to Raammee in John Smith's Cup over C&D (good to firm) in July; weakened quickly at Ascot four weeks ago but he has already shown this season that he's capable of bouncing back from a poor run.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Acts on good to soft; won in Britain and Bahrain during his spell with George Scott; off five months (had wind surgery) and shaped as if needing the race when last of four at Redcar (1m2f) for new yard five weeks ago; his claims aren't obvious.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressive last autumn and rediscovered that thread to win at Redcar (1m, good) in May; hasn't been running badly over about 1m2f subsequently but needs something extra if he's to take this.

RaceName: Sky Bet Dav Reid Finale Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: C&D winner on good in June but held off this mark in a Class 3 over 1m1f at Hamilton 11 days ago and this is even harder.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
Spotlight: Record of 1-11, the win in a 7f maiden for the Gosdens; two near misses in handicaps at about 1m this summer and reportedly ran flat last time; hard to dismiss.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
Spotlight: C&D winner last month off 8lb lower and the following week suffered a fall at York; good to see him bounce back from that with a respectable show at Hamilton; this mark might be on the high side.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
Spotlight: Third run for this yard when a head winner at Thirsk (7f, good) and was bang there in a big field at York (good to firm) despite a troubled passage; stays 1m and plenty to like.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
Spotlight: Form figures of 6888 since leaving William Haggas; has dropped 10lb for his troubles but best watched for now.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
Spotlight: Last season ended well, following her maiden win with a near miss off 1lb lower at Newmarket (7f); yet to recapture that form this campaign (7f/1m), though she was sent to Ascot and Goodwood; better expected.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
Spotlight: Dual AW winner, latterly in March when in first-time cheekpieces, after which he finished last of the four at Wolverhampton (scoped dirty); could be given another chance but he's been off since April.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
Spotlight: Admirable veteran who recently completed a hat-trick over 1m2f before disappointing last week at Doncaster; has to bounce back from that, but he should be fine returned to 1m.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
Spotlight: Won a handicap over a similar trip for Joseph O'Brien whom he left for 28,000gns; started slowly and never involved on last week's stable debut (7f, good; 33-1).

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
Spotlight: Four-time winner at Pontefract where he was competitive last month; for whatever reason he never gave his running last week at Thirsk.

RaceName: Marske Fabrications And Engineering Handicap (Marske Fabrications And Engineering Qualifier)
OwnerName: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
Spotlight: Sole win was on the AW during the winter (7f); pretty ordinary since then, with and without a hood.

RaceName: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Huge improvement from debut run to win here last month, coming off the pace to beat a horse well beaten since; more needed again here, but respected.

RaceName: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Workmanlike winner of a Kilbeggan bumper in May and ran respectably under a penalty at Bellewstown; in new hands now and more needed, but should run his race.

RaceName: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Runner-up on debut at Punchestown and showed a very good attitude to win at Galway; likely to have a bit more use made of him here and will be tough to get past.

RaceName: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Well beaten but showed some progression on his second start at Wexford; much more needed here.

RaceName: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Third foal; dam unplaced bumpers/hurdles, half-sister to point winner Katishna, out of half-sister to smart 3m hurdler/chaser Pleasure Shared and to the dam of smart chaser Southern Vic; staying pedigree and likely to do better with time and distance.

RaceName: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Half-brother to a couple of winners and bred for stamina; pulled up in his sole point-to-point.

RaceName: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Didn't get the rub of the green when a fine second on debut here last month; sure to improve and be a big player here.

RaceName: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Eighth foal; closely related to useful 2m-2m1f hurdle/chase winner Downmexicoway, half-brother to winners Dhowin (2m3f hurdle/3m2f chase), Straight Home (bumper/2m-3m hurdle) and Lady Walk On Bye (bumper); dam unplaced 2m hurdles; nicely bred newcomer but almost certainly best watched.

RaceName: Laurels Pub (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race
Spotlight: Pulled up in a Thurles maiden hurdle for Eddie Power in March; hard to fancy on debut for Eoin McCarthy.

RaceName: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Last seen on Flat in 2024 for Mick Appleby and has a chance if resuming in similar vein; 4-8 as a fairly useful hurdler (ran respectably on latest start) for current yard since; considered.

RaceName: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Bit to prove on softer than good; two wins followed by two Goodwood places on his only four appearances over 2m for Emma Lavelle; first run for new connections was voided before the race warmed up; made most when well beaten trying 2m4f in a Class 2 at Glorious Goodwood three weeks ago but has a competitive mark in this Class 4.

RaceName: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Won 11.6f and 1m6f (good to soft) handicaps last year for the Gosden yard; Flat reappearance fourth over C&D in May was respectable but two lesser displays (1m6f/1m4f) have followed; others have more pressing claims.

RaceName: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ex-Alan King, with new yard this year; overall 0-7 over hurdles and 1-22 on the Flat; return to this sphere over 1m4f here (20-1) three weeks ago wasn't greatly persuasive but he is well down the weights.

RaceName: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 1-22 for Alan King, with his sole win in June 2024; had a respectable first two runs for new yard over C&D this season, before tailed off on good to firm at York four weeks ago; now 6lb below his peak mark.

RaceName: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Edging down weights for new yard; first three of those four runs were here and the second piece of form (2m, good; unraced on softer) gives him a chance.

RaceName: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Made all twice last season, latterly in good style over 1m6f here (heavy) in September; just 1lb higher today after lesser shows this term but the latest was a step back in the right direction and he stays 2m; case can be made.

RaceName: Celebrate National Racehorse Week Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Baker Stables LLC, Scanlan Racing LLC & Michael Golovko
Spotlight: Progressed into very useful filly in 2025, winning five times including Grade 3 Torry Pines Stakes here (1m; by half a length) in August; improved again last two starts, winning Grade 2 Santa Margarita at Santa Anita (9f; easily by 4l) in May before half-length second to Eunomia in Clement L. Hirsch Stakes here (8.5f) this month; tougher task against makes and has to prove stamina.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: C2 Racing Stable LLC, Mathis Stable LLC & TCC Stables LLC
Spotlight: Hard-charging front-runner; got loose early in Grade 2 at Santa Anita in May (1m2f) and proceeded to register very smart effort in winning by nearly 10l from Malarchuk; nowhere near same level in the face of even mild pressure, including last time, and will not find this group accommodating.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Japanese-trained colt by Gun Runner; won Listed Tokyo Derby at Ohi in June (1m2f, muddy) by about a length in 16-runner field (second-fastest time in race history); it's hard to be confident how he fits in terms of class but he is nicely drawn; promising young trainer saddled 2024 Breeders' Cup Turf runner-up Rousham Park.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: High-class horse at his best, winner of three Grade 1s, two in Argentina and California Crown Stakes at Santa Anita (1m1f) in September 2024; not the same force of old and tailed off in Grade 2 last time; opposed.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: ERJ Racing LLC & Reddam Racing LLC
Spotlight: Useful form, lightly raced; runner-up at Santa Anita in 2026 in allowance race and Grade 2 Hollywood Gold Cup (1m2f), in latter beaten nearly 10l by Forged Steel after latter established a clear early lead; needs to step up a good deal to defeat these.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Curlin colt who won Grade 3 Blame Stakes at Churchill Downs (1m1f) in May; stiffer task when well-beaten ninth in Grade 2 Suburban Stakes at Saratoga (1m2f) last time (Forged Steel fifth); this is more difficult still.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Late-running stamina glutton who got the perfect set-up in 2025 Dubai World Cup at Meydan (1m2f); creditable efforts this term when placed in Grade 3 Blame at Churchill Downs (1m1f; travelled strongly, short of room, caught eye in third) and Grade 2 Suburban at Saratoga (did best of the closers, 10l second to impressive front-runner Phileas Fogg); could get perfect set-up here with so much early pace signed on and looks to be coming to the boil.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Slam Dunk Racing, Debby Baltas & Cynthia McClanahan
Spotlight: Clearly best effort to win five-runner Grade 1 Santa Anita Handicap (1m2f) in March by 5l from Vodka Vodka; disappointing since in Grade 3 at Keeneland and Grade 2 Hollywood Gold Cup (1m2f), in latter 10l behind Forged Steel; hard to trust.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Bag Racing Stables, Miller Racing Et Al
Spotlight: In tremendous form, completing hat-trick in allowance at Gulfstream and Grade 3s at Pimlico (9.5f) and Prairie Meadows (9f); set strong pace and stayed on well to win by three and a half lengths from Bullard in Cornhusker Handicap on latter occasion; should give another good account but this is tougher.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: First home of the front-runners when third to Skippylongstocking in strongly run Grade 1 Pegasus World Cup at Gulfstream (1m1f) in January, then stumbled badly start when 3l fourth to Nu What's New in Grade 3 Oaklawn Mile in March; runner-up two years ago and looks to have been laid out (trainer has won this four times) but faces so much pressure up front.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: High-class horse, devastating in hat-trick of Grade 3 wins at Gulfstream last winter (all in very fast time); back to form when winning Grade 3 Monmouth Cup (1m1f) by just over 10l from Money Game; has lots of early pace but has to overcome wide draw, pace pressure and needs to prove stamina at 1m2f; highly respected but may start at cramped odds, considering difficulties.
